explanation: Enrique Corcuera built the first court at his house in Mexico. A Spanish friend, Alfonso de Hohenlohe, took the game to Marbella, and from there it spread across Spain.

claims.text: Padel was invented in 1969 by Enrique Corcuera at his home in Acapulco, Mexico.
Padel was not invented in Marbella, Buenos Aires or Barcelona.
Alfonso de Hohenlohe built the first padel courts in Spain, at Marbella, after playing the game in Acapulco.
